build.profile: a 19 mm body ring section and a 18.4 mm interference tube (a shotgun), 250 mm long, a rounded cap; the real tube is also 19 mm over most of its length, the 0.6 mm step only marks the seam. No product photo was opened for this device, so the silhouette is a plausible lathe profile drawn from the published length and widest diameter, NOT measured from a photo or drawing: the size is exact, the shape between the stations is an estimate (confidence guess).

A matt black tube with six columns of long interference slots. out-xlr: on the base (bottom) face at its centre; no drawing gives it, so the confidence is guess.
